title: Malls for me are not abandoned
content: Hi there, I’ve been going through the sub for a bit and it seems like *abandoned* malls are the most common. For me, the malls are always bustling with people and almost have like a casino/vegas type vibe to them. They’re usually full of obnoxious neon lights and crowds I have to weave my way through. On top of this, they’re not realistic at all. If I look up I can see thousands upon thousands of additional floors and it always feels very overwhelming to me. I’m usually by myself in these dreams, either starting alone or getting separated from a group. Most of the time I feel uneasy but also somewhat excited? Like an adrenaline rush or something similar. Has anyone else had this too?
